# Records-Before-Reverse-Engineering

Prior artefacts are cheaper than rediscovering constraints from scratch.

## Read first

Results logs, notes from earlier attempts, configuration snippets, and relevant branch tips—these anchor hypotheses.

## Hypothesis quality

Ground hypotheses in observed outputs. Premature certainty wastes turns.

## After diagnosis

Once the defect class is named, move to fix-and-prove. Additional exploratory reads rarely beat a tight patch with verification.

## Documentation asks

When the deliverable is prose tied to the codebase, cite concrete identifiers from real artefacts—accuracy beats fluent paraphrase.
